proposals.title: Annual Report Disclosing How Risks Related to Public Concern over Drug Pricing Strategies are Incorporated into Executive Compensation Plans
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on the extent to which risks related to public concern over drug pricing are integrated into senior executive incentive compensation arrangements.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment giving holders of 15% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" the proposal.
